text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonia submits a draft resolution in the United Nations against violent disintegration of states. Macedonia expects the Security Council to adopt it in December.
- The Macedonian foreign ministry prepared five proposals for cooperation with Greece in the field of economy, ecology and prevention of crime.
- Macedonian air company Palair Macedonia definitely grounded. The destiny of 300 employees uncertain.
- Macedonian government allowed import of 14,000 tonnes of oil derivatives, enough to cover domestic market needs for 40 days.
- Political parties in Macedonia continue their electoral campaign ahead of November 17 local elections.
